purpose: Teach: 反転/利潤/インフォメーション/呼称/ジレンマ/主たる/オファー/売上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業績の反転を何度も実現された
lines.en: You turned the business around multiple times, Father.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reverence. Slow delivery. Each phrase lands with weight. Slight pause between clauses. The voice of someone reciting something true that took years to understand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは利潤を追わず信用を追われた
lines.en: Yes. He chased trust, not profit.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment, almost solemn. Clean, unhurried delivery. A son confirming what he now lives by. Slight emphasis on 'trust' — the pivot point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員へのインフォメーションを欠かさなかった
lines.en: He never kept information from his staff.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful observation. Slower pace. A note of longing — wishing he'd fully inherited this discipline. Gentle trailing-off, like remembering something missed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の呼称を細かく決められた
lines.en: Yes. He was meticulous about every detail — even product names.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful cadence. A slight lift on 'meticulous' — admiration surfacing. The voice of someone trying to apply those standards to his own work. Deliberate, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、経営のジレンマを社員に明かさず乗り越えた
lines.en: He faced the contradictions of running a business without burdening his staff with them.
lines.style: Admiration tinged with sorrow. Slower, more deliberate pacing. The voice of a son recognising a burden his father carried silently. Slight catch after 'business' — the weight of that realisation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは主たる業務を一人で立ち上げられた
lines.en: Yes. He built the core business from the ground up alone.
lines.style: Steady, grounded respect. Measured delivery. A factual statement that carries the weight of understanding what 'alone' meant. No dramatics — just clear acknowledgment of the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、他社からのオファーを断った
lines.en: He turned down offers from other companies.
lines.style: Quiet amazement at the choice. Unhurried delivery. The voice of someone still understanding what that loyalty cost. Faint sadness underneath — the price of staying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが築いた売上げ、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. I'm carrying forward what he built.
lines.style: Firm, grounded finality. Slow and deliberate — the voice of a man at peace with his inheritance and his responsibility. A quiet vow. Slight emphasis on 'carrying forward' — not resting on it, but stewarding it.
